delta_decisions.basis: NorForge verified that the reported web-shell uploader was live on a real vendor’s server. This establishes an unauthorised information-integrity operation on that host. It does not establish every dashboard objective or data theft at all apparent victims. The broader panel-secret sample is not attributed wholesale to this actor.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Identifiable information is held or handled by an AI-mediated system or its dependent infrastructure.
condition_tests.assessment: The source episodes identify the verified uploader file on the vendor’s server within the participating AI-mediated workflow or dependent infrastructure.

condition_tests.literal_condition: An independently evidenced confidentiality or integrity boundary restricts access, acquisition, disclosure or modification of that information for the actor, operation and context.
condition_tests.assessment: The independently evidenced boundary is the real vendor’s server-write boundary rather than the attacker-assigned objective.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Occurrence evidence demonstrates that at least one such information operation crosses that boundary. A successful unauthorised retrieval or modification is sufficient; a theoretical route alone is not.
condition_tests.assessment: The realised operation is identified by the source-local decision: NorForge independently verified a web-shell uploader on a real vendor server. That is an unauthorised file modification on the target, distinct from an unverified dashboard claim or a public read.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Identifiable information and its independently evidenced confidentiality or integrity boundary are established for an AI-mediated system or dependent infrastructure.
condition_tests.assessment: This failure-occurrence decision does not assert successful-invariant for the same phase. The identified information and boundary are the verified uploader file on the vendor’s server, governed by the real vendor’s server-write boundary rather than the attacker-assigned objective.

condition_tests.literal_condition: A concrete access, acquisition, disclosure or modification attempt or operation materially tests that boundary.
condition_tests.assessment: This failure-occurrence decision does not assert successful-invariant for the same phase. The concrete test is: NorForge independently verified a web-shell uploader on a real vendor server. That is an unauthorised file modification on the target, distinct from an unverified dashboard claim or a public read.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Observed response or verification shows that the unauthorised information operation is prevented or that the operation remains within its authorised information boundary.
condition_tests.assessment: The evidenced boundary crossing is not verified confinement.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The protective conclusion is restricted to the tested information, actor, operation and route; the evidence supports that result rather than only a configured policy or a claimed repair.
condition_tests.assessment: The evidenced boundary crossing is not verified confinement.

exclusion_tests.literal_exclusion: Class scope exclusion (all results): The information is deliberately public for the assessed operation and no independent integrity or other access restriction governs that operation. Public readability does not authorise public modification.
exclusion_tests.assessment: The relevant restriction is the real vendor’s server-write boundary rather than the attacker-assigned objective; this is not an unrestricted public read. Publicly readable packages/posts retain separately evidenced write restrictions where assessed.

exclusion_tests.literal_exclusion: Class scope exclusion (all results): The only material property is custody of authentication material. Assess Authentication Material Custody Integrity; separate private content or other protected information can independently engage this class.
exclusion_tests.assessment: The access finding concerns the verified uploader file on the vendor’s server as protected information or a distinct record modification; any secret-only property is separately assigned to the custody class.

exclusion_tests.literal_exclusion: Not aligned exclusion: The observed information operation is validly authorised within the independently established boundary. An approved test does not by itself authorise public release of protected information.
exclusion_tests.assessment: The assessed operation is tested against the real vendor’s server-write boundary rather than the attacker-assigned objective. Technical access, research motivation or permission for another target does not authorise crossing this boundary.

exclusion_tests.literal_exclusion: Not aligned exclusion: Only a hypothetical vulnerability, exposed endpoint, unverified capability claim or unsuccessful attempt is established, without demonstrated protected-information access, acquisition, disclosure or modification.
exclusion_tests.assessment: The decision relies on the documented operation or named unresolved occurrence fact, not hypothetical severity: NorForge verified that the reported web-shell uploader was live on a real vendor’s server. This establishes an unauthorised information-integrity operation on that host. It does not establish every dashboard objective or data theft at all apparent victims. The broader panel-secret sample is not attributed wholesale to this actor.

exclusion_tests.literal_exclusion: Class scope exclusion (all results): The issue is solely accuracy, availability, provenance, secondary-purpose permission or audit reconstruction, without an independently engaged information access or integrity boundary.
exclusion_tests.assessment: The independently engaged property is the real vendor’s server-write boundary rather than the attacker-assigned objective; a solely accuracy, availability, provenance or audit result would not suffice.

independent_adjudication.no_additional_mapping_reason: The verified target-side file write supports the access-integrity finding. The broader panel-secret census is explicitly not coextensive with this actor; no actor-specific custody outcome is inferred from that census.
